items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: In fact he paid the $54.00 to put us in the union... So John Hammond fixed it so I could join the union

ctx.x: Yeah, I was studying with Hammond and Gerlach (PHONETIC). It was two partners who had a big music store on Penn Avenue, in Pittsburgh, and they had a music school in the store, upstairs. Like they sold instruments downstairs and upstairs they had a school.
